files.name: Next Signer 1.1.2
files.notes: Fixes false signing failure on apps such as Ksign. Uses Zsign signing success plus signed-bundle validation instead of the unreliable Zsign Mach-O checkSigned result. Keeps local P12 + mobileprovision signing, export, and publish-after-sign flow.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.1 LevelPlay Test
files.notes: Test build with Unity LevelPlay monetization integration: adaptive bottom banner plus frequency-limited interstitial after five successful post generations. Ad loading remains non-blocking while the LevelPlay account is pending approval.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.0
files.notes: Next Solution X post generator. Pulls automated articles from nextsolution.cc, generates non-repeating X-ready posts with article link, SEO-focused descriptions and hashtags, supports copy, Open in X, source article access, and persistent generated-post counters.

files.name: NextLock 1.1.4 RootHide
files.notes: NextLock 1.1.4 adds four simultaneous custom photo/sticker frames. Each frame has its own photo, enable switch, width, height, Time/Date anchor, placement and X/Y position. Frame 1 migrates the existing photo layout.

files.name: NextLock 1.1.4 Rootless
files.notes: NextLock 1.1.4 adds four simultaneous custom photo/sticker frames. Each frame has its own photo, enable switch, width, height, Time/Date anchor, placement and X/Y position. Frame 1 migrates the existing photo layout.

files.name: Module Glass 1.1.12 Transition Recovery RootHide
files.notes: Device test for the expansion freeze: removes broad layout/disappear transition cleanup, suspends once on an actual size transition, ignores stale completion callbacks, and only restores Module Glass after compact Control Center geometry is stable.

files.name: Module Glass 1.1.12 Transition Recovery Source
files.notes: Exact matching source for the 1.1.12 RootHide transition-recovery test build.

files.name: NS Admin 1.0.4
files.notes: Fixes the missing Devices tab glyph on iOS 16 and adds device model + iOS version to activation requests and active-device cards. Keeps server-backed active device tracking, direct revoke, request handoff and TrollStore-safe token storage.

Expansion-safety device test: pre-cleans custom visual state before module expansion, suspends rendering during expanded transitions, and restores the validated 1.1.10 renderer only after compact mode returns.
files.name: Module Glass 1.1.11 Complete RootHide

files.notes: Auto Log Collector release. One-tap full Module Glass test enables the real Stable Recovery verbose runtime logger, refreshes tracked Control Center controllers, checks every module image, parses per-module SpringBoard diagnostics, saves .log + .json automatically, and auto-uploads when a Keychain GitHub token is configured.
